propositions: Recovery operation must be invoked once at the validated write-bearing reconcile boundary after the under-lock staleness gate and before the first remote fetch to prevent interleaving fresh liveness evidence with retirement completion
Read-only commands and filtered paths must perform zero writes during recovery operation invocation
A durable tombstone is authoritative and cannot be revoked by automatic confirmations, absence resets, or same-key confirmations; only explicit unretire removes it
On completion failure the overlap must be preserved for retry and structurally cannot have made remote calls since the invocation precedes the fetch
The repair_at_write_boundary guard must refuse non-write-bearing or scoped passes without classification or repository reads, returning immediately with no observable output for read-only paths
